usb_phy.switch_note: Connect PC2_C/PC3_C to their digital GPIO through SYSCFG analog switches; this package does not expose separate PC2/PC3 pins.

split_usb_c_cc.purpose: Split connector attach/power management, not the PC upstream connector
split_usb_c_cc.driver: Explicit C85 interrupt-driven I2C source policy

split_power.enable_policy: Only after USB configured/power budget ready; fault and suspend must return to blocked state

physical_direction_note: Right half is a mirrored mechanical assembly. Determine encoder sign on hardware; do not assume identical A/B polarity produces the same user-facing rotation.
keymap_note: CAPS/Q/W/E/R/SHIFT/SPACE/1/4 are physical source labels on both halves, not an approved right-half HID keymap. Default usages are a software policy and remain remappable.
legacy_warning: C8 11-key/four-MX descriptions and WeAct PA11/PA12 USB-FS builds do not describe C77.

c85_delta.copper_and_electrical_qualification: Separate hardware review, not certified by pin comparison
